purpose: Provide a bounded candidate protocol for authenticated runtime-clock epoch replacement after clock-chain failure while preventing stale secretary pressure, terminal-hold, Experience, appraisal, personality, and P_base carryover.
required_invariants: Clock epoch trust snapshot is signed by the current synthetic LCR-A signer epoch and bound to the current signer trust snapshot id.
Replacement clock epoch must bind the exact previous clock snapshot hash, rotate epoch/key identity, and explicitly revoke the prior clock epoch.
Clock epoch root mutation is serialized through the current external-monotonic-provider interface and rejects local durability-domain aliasing.

Recovery is non-terminal and enters CLOCK_EPOCH_RECOVERED_AWAITING_FRESH_AUTHORITY_AND_CLOCK with UNKNOWN secretary state, zero pressure history, zero Experience, zero operational progress, and no live/formal authority.
Fresh authority re-entry must bind the same fresh Mission Git blob used by clock recovery.
Old epoch checkpoints, receipts, and epoch-bound secretary observations cannot cross the recovery barrier.
Only a fresh current-epoch signed secretary observation plus a current-epoch authenticated clock receipt may repopulate routing pressure.
Authority conflict always zeroes secretary routing effect.
Recovery, clock, provider, and secretary metadata are excluded from Experience, personality, P_base, appraisal reward, trauma, relief, familiarity, dependency, and capability claims.
required_regressions: clock-chain break fails closed and authenticated new epoch re-enters neutrally
old clock checkpoint and old epoch pressure cannot cross recovery
only fresh current-epoch pressure can route after recovery
current-epoch checkpoint advances from exact current-epoch receipt hash
old local clock root rollback is detected by external provider floor
replacement must revoke old clock epoch
fresh Mission blob change blocks recovery
recovery metadata is excluded from learning/personality/appraisal/P_base
known_remaining_gaps: A real rollback-independent monotonic provider is not installed or Reality-verified.
Synthetic clock and secretary keys do not prove protected production key custody, rotation ceremony, or compromise recovery.
This candidate excludes historical pressure by construction at the clock boundary but still requires W03 counterfactual review of downstream appraisal/drive/exploration caches.
Terminal-exit authenticated envelope and the shared v2/v2.1 authoritative event classifier remain separate future closures.
Formal adoption still requires current W02/W03/W04 evidence, zero unresolved adoption veto, paired speed evidence, and normal A-to-B-to-C verification.
